commit.message:
Broaden messaging to cover all short-form video platforms

Update website copy and SEO metadata to focus on mindless scrolling
across multiple platforms (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) rather than
just Instagram. This reflects the app's expanded platform support.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Update metadata titles for improved clarity and SEO
add Open Graph image for improved SEO and social sharing
remove sacroll based images for the mobile view

Refactor image handling in CTABanner, FeaturesSection, and HeroSection components - Replaced tags with component from Next.js for optimized image loading. - Added width and height attributes to images for better performance and layout stability. - Updated text formatting in CTABanner for consistent apostrophe usage.
fix cta section and feature section for mobile view

Update text formatting in CTABanner and FeaturesSection components

- Changed apostrophes to HTML entities for better compatibility in CTABanner and FeaturesSection.
- Ensured consistent text rendering across components.

Refactor homepage structure and add new components

- Removed the old HeroSection implementation and replaced it with a new structure that includes HeroSection, FeaturesSection, CTABanner, and Footer components.
- Added new components: CTABanner, FeaturesSection, and Footer, enhancing the homepage layout and functionality.
- Introduced new images and updated font imports for better styling.
- Deleted unused vercel.svg file and added new images for the detoxie features.
